question: What is the name of the two small moons orbiting Mars discovered by American astronomer Asaph Hall in 1877?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Phobos and Deimos.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The two small moons orbiting Mars discovered by American astronomer Asaph Hall in 1877 are Phobos and Deimos.**
 
• **Phobos**:-
 
 
• It is the larger of the two moons, and its name means "fear" in Greek mythology.
 
 
 
• **Deimos**:-
 
 
• It is smaller than Phobos and its name means "panic" in Greek mythology.
 
 
 
• **Both Phobos and Deimos are irregularly shaped and are thought to be captured asteroids or fragments of the Martian crust.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Miranda and Triton are moons of Uranus and Neptune.
 
• Enceladus and Titan are moons of Saturn, and Charon and Dysnomia are moons of Pluto.
